feed.headline: Trump’s Deal With Russia Inflames Ukraine War He Vowed to End
feed.ai: The Ukrainian president’s defiant decision to continue attacking Russian refineries underscores President Trump’s inability to end a war he had promised to resolve.
feed.frag: Highlights the limits of national coordination

feed.headline: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
feed.ai: The US president temporarily ends many restrictions on Moscow recently passed by Congress over "national security" concerns.

feed.headline: Trump 'completely wrong' to restrict support for Ukraine, Italian minister tells BBC
feed.ai: Defence Minister Guido Crosetto tells the BBC the US risks prolonging Russia's full-scale invasion rather than helping to end it.

feed.headline: Zelensky says Ukraine has right to defend itself after Trump calls latest strikes a 'disgrace'
feed.ai: EU leaders rally around Ukraine's president after new criticism from Donald Trump, who says Zelensky is "more difficult to work with than Putin".

feed.headline: Trump denies limiting Ukraine access to Starlink network
feed.ai: Speed curbs limited Ukraine's defences against deadly Russian attacks on Tuesday night.

feed.headline: Are student protests being manipulated ahead of France's presidential election?
feed.ai: France's prime minister has suggested that student anger is being weaponised, as the unions and other protesters prepare to take to the streets too.

feed.headline: They fled Russia, but the West sent them back
feed.ai: Over the past year there has been a stark rise in anti-government activists deported to Russia from the EU and US where they were seeking refuge.

feed.headline: Inside Ukrainian offensive pushing Russia back - with Starlink playing a key role
feed.ai: The BBC joins Ukraine's Operation Vivaldi as it regains crucial territory in the Donbas, but optimism has been dampened by souring relations with President Trump.

feed.headline: Why the prime minister wants to talk about Brexit again
feed.ai: For the first time since the UK left the EU, we have a prime minister who will "unflinchingly" debate Brexit, says the BBC's political editor Chris Mason.

feed.headline: The Rupturing Trump-Zelensky Relationship Stands to Hurt Ukraine and Its European Allies
feed.ai: Where the two presidents’ war of words will end is anybody’s guess. But if it continues, it could threaten the crucial operational help that Ukraine still gets from the United States.

feed.headline: Belgium: Pumpkimania festival takes over Groot-Bijgaarden Castle
feed.ai: Foxes, owls and deer made from pumpkins have taken over Groot-Bijgaarden Castle near Brussels. The Pumpkimania festival features a 772kg giant, pumpkin boat rides and Halloween activities until 1 November.

feed.headline: Russian missiles spark huge factory fires in Ukraine’s Odesa and Zaporizhzhia
feed.ai: Russian strikes ignited massive fires at businesses in Odesa and Zaporizhzhia as President Zelensky met European leaders for talks.
